description: This file defines the QR class for performing QR decomposition using Householder reflections, including methods for obtaining Q, R matrices, and solving least squares problems.

classes.name: QR
classes.description: Class implementing QR decomposition with Householder reflections, providing methods to retrieve Q, R matrices, check rank, and solve linear systems.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes QR object with a matrix and performs decomposition.

methods.name: getHouseholdVectors
methods.description: Returns the Householder vectors as a Matrix.

methods.name: getQ
methods.description: Constructs and returns the orthogonal matrix Q from the decomposition.

methods.name: getR
methods.description: Constructs and returns the upper triangular matrix R from the decomposition.

methods.name: hypo
methods.description: Calculates the hypotenuse (Euclidean norm) of two values.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Performs QR decomposition using Householder reflections.

methods.name: isFullRank
methods.description: Checks if the matrix is of full rank based on R diagonal elements.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solves the least squares problem A*X = B using the QR decomposition.
